title: Balanced International Merchandise Trade Statistics: the goods each economy exports to each other, by year
provider: OECD, Statistics and Data Directorate: BIMTS, the HS2017 2-digit dataflow, total of all goods, through the OECD's SDMX API
licence: CC BY 4.0 (the OECD's terms and conditions for its data)
citation: OECD, Balanced International Merchandise Trade Statistics (BIMTS), dataflow OECD.SDD.TPS:DSD_BIMTS@DF_BIMTS_HS2017_2D version 1.1, https://data-explorer.oecd.org
format: CSV (SDMX csvfile): REF_AREA the exporter, COUNTERPART_AREA the importer (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, with OECD aggregates), TIME_PERIOD the year, OBS_VALUE in millions of US dollars at market exchange rates (UNIT_MULT 6). Balanced values reconcile each pair's exporter and importer reports; B_ADJ_RX also adjusts for re-exports, attributing goods passed through a hub to their origin.
coverage: about 200 economies as reporters and partners, 2010 to 2024 (one request of about 50 MB for all years)

adjustment.description: B, balanced values; B_ADJ_RX, balanced values adjusted for re-exports

total-goods.description: All goods, balanced and adjusted for re-exports, 2010-2024
